ticker: US carries out targeted strikes on Iran
Delhi imposes GRAP-III restrictions as AQI worsens
Microsoft ends Oracle AI cloud capacity deal
ONGC targets Venezuelan oil project operations
US sanctions Canadian entities over Iran ties

articles.headline: US carries out targeted strikes on Iranian targets
articles.brief: The US military executed fresh targeted strikes in Iran, knocking out anti-aircraft devices as Tehran weighs mediator proposals and distributes iodine pills amid escalating fears.

articles.headline: US sanctions Canadian companies over Iran transactions
articles.brief: The United States Treasury has imposed sanctions on eight Canadian entities and money services firms accused of enabling unauthorized international transactions involving Iran.

articles.headline: Delhi enforces GRAP-III restrictions as AQI hits toxic levels
articles.brief: With Delhi's average air quality index soaring to 382 near severe thresholds ahead of Diwali, the Commission for Air Quality Management has invoked strict GRAP Stage III restrictions.

articles.headline: Microsoft winds down Oracle AI cloud capacity rental deal
articles.brief: Microsoft is terminating its multi-year AI cloud rental agreement with Oracle, prompting Oracle's free cash flow to drop and its stock to decline significantly following reassessed commitments.

articles.headline: Alphabet acquires stake in Qualcomm to drive data center push
articles.brief: Google parent Alphabet has secured a $548 million stake in technology partner Qualcomm as part of an aggressive strategic push into expanding advanced data center capabilities.

articles.headline: India's ONGC targets Venezuelan oil project operations
articles.brief: State-owned ONGC expects to secure operational rights for two critical Venezuelan oil projects within the next six months, bolstering international energy cooperation.

articles.headline: India stocks post best week in six years
articles.brief: Bucking a broader global technology rout, Indian stock markets closed a stellar week with significant gains, marking their strongest weekly performance in six years.

articles.headline: India bowlers dominate New Zealand in ODI clash
articles.brief: Mirroring historic bowling performances, Indian pacers utilized testing conditions to keep New Zealand batters under intense pressure, continuing their dominant series form.

articles.headline: Supreme Court clarifies creamy layer verdict applicability
articles.brief: The Supreme Court of India ruled that its recent creamy layer judgment will exclusively apply to individuals who formally challenged the government's contested decision.

articles.headline: TSMC explores expanding into advanced memory chip manufacturing
articles.brief: Semiconductor giant TSMC is reportedly evaluating plans to venture into advanced memory chip production to meet soaring AI hardware and computing demands.

articles.headline: France braces for widespread yellow vest disobedience protests
articles.brief: French authorities are preparing for mass demonstrations and civil disobedience protests called by yellow vest movements across major cities amid rising economic tensions.

articles.headline: Enforcement Directorate probes foreign funds meddling in India
articles.brief: India's Enforcement Directorate is tracking a $1.5 million international funding trail across multiple countries, investigating alleged foreign interference in domestic affairs.

articles.headline: Amazon introduces text-based shopping integration with Alexa
articles.brief: Amazon has rolled out a new text-based shopping feature on Alexa, allowing users to effortlessly research, compare products, track price drops, and complete purchases.

articles.headline: Maharashtra leases reservoir land for fodder in drought areas
articles.brief: To mitigate severe livestock shortages during the ongoing dry season, the Maharashtra government is leasing reservoir land for fodder cultivation across 304 drought-hit talukas.
